definition: a container for carrying money and small items
description: A woman with long braids in a bright orange and blue patterned dress stands on a sunny city street with a plain tote over one shoulder. She holds a paper gift bag open by its handles and leans over it, eyes wide and mouth open with delight at what is inside. The clip cuts to her walking down the bright concourse of a shopping centre towards the camera with three or four paper shop bags hanging from each hand, past lit shopfronts. It ends on a rising escalator: she stands with bags stacked over both forearms and holds up a patterned brown leather handbag in one hand and a large black leather holdall in the other, grinning straight at the camera.

en.question: What is the woman showing off?
